serviceDescription: 111 Sky Advisors (Jaiz Partners LP) is an advisory firm, not an assessor. We prepare documentation and evidence packages for cloud service providers pursuing FedRAMP 20x Class A, B or C. The provider is accountable for the accuracy of its package and applies on its own behalf.

servicesOffered.serviceName: FedRAMP 20x Class A documentation and evidence preparation
servicesOffered.serviceDescription: We help SaaS providers prepare the Key Security Indicator summaries and the evidence index they submit for Class A. The provider reviews, attests to and submits its own package.

servicesOffered.serviceName: FedRAMP 20x Class B and Class C documentation and evidence preparation
servicesOffered.serviceDescription: We help cloud providers prepare the Key Security Indicator and provider-rule documentation, keep the independent-assessment timeline and give their assessor an evidence index. We are not an assessor and do not build the provider's automation. The provider reviews, attests to and submits its own package.
A review of the provider's existing SOC 2 Type II, GovRAMP or Rev5 material against the Class A entry requirements, with a written list of gaps.
Help assembling the provider's quarterly ongoing certification report from its own records.
